includes: About This Trip This 2-2.5 hour guided adventure includes an intermediate paddle upstream with a relaxing drift back to the launch site.
gap: All Sales Final: Once booked, all sales are final, and no cancellations are permitted unless specified otherwise. Trip protection is an available add on option for more flexibility. blurb: Adventure with us as we watch the sunset and paddle through a peaceful cove at Grapevine Lake. Soak in nature as the sun goes down and the sky turns pink and orange reflecting on the calm waters. You may also be able to spot osprey, egrets, great blue herons, turtles, ducks and a beaver.
